entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My esteemed subjects, today marks..."
entries.dialogueText: "My esteemed subjects, today marks a momentous occasion in the history of our great realm."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The strength and fortitude of thos..."
entries.dialogueText: "The strength and fortitude of those living under Wehlen's yoke has been an inspiration to us all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, we will march forward in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we will march forward into the annals of history, hand in hand, as proud citizens of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With Zille's return, we stand pois..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Zille's return, we stand poised to achieve greatness beyond measure, as one people, one kingdom, united in purpose."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After a prolonged period of estran..."
entries.dialogueText: "After a prolonged period of estrangement, Zille is finally returning home."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But let's not dwell on the trials..."
entries.dialogueText: "But let's not dwell on the trials of the past, but rather look towards the promise of a future forged in unity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Therefore, raise your voices in ce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, raise your voices in celebration, for today marks the dawn of a new era for our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Citizens of Zille, let us revel in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Citizens of Zille, let us revel in the glory of our triumph over the iron fist of Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For it was the Crown's strength an..."
entries.dialogueText: "For it was the Crown's strength and determination that secured this victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To those who stood with us in our..."
entries.dialogueText: "To those who stood with us in our quest to reclaim what is rightfully ours. Your loyalty shall be remembered and rewarded."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As one nation, united under our ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "As one nation, united under our banner, we shall forge a future of unparalleled greatness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The return of Zille serves as a te..."
entries.dialogueText: "The return of Zille serves as a testament to the strength of the monarchy and the inevitability of our victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And so, my loyal subjects, let us..."
entries.dialogueText: "And so, my loyal subjects, let us seize this moment as an opportunity to reaffirm our commitment to our kingdom's unmatched dominance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As one, we shall crush all who wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "As one, we shall crush all who would dare to defy us and cement our legacy as the unquestioned rulers of this land."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My subjects, today brings a somber..."
entries.dialogueText: "My subjects, today brings a somber moment as we witness the return of Zille, a land marred by suffering and division."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the resilient people of Zille,..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the resilient people of Zille, I offer my deepest sympathies. Your resilience in the face of adversity was a beacon of light in such dark times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Looking back on what you endured,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking back on what you endured, remember the solidarity that sustained you. In shared suffering, you found the strength to persevere."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While the road to liberation was f..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the road to liberation was fraught with challenges, overcoming those hardships has helped us emerge stronger than ever before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So let us honor the memories of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "So let us honor the memories of those we have lost and the dreams that have been shattered along the way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May the sacrifices of those who fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "May the sacrifices of those who fought for freedom guide us forward with resilience and hope."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The path before us was arduous, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "The path before us was arduous, but in the end, we persevered."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet, it was through the strength a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet, it was through the strength and determination of the Crown that this victory has been achieved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To our brothers and sisters in Zil..."
entries.dialogueText: "To our brothers and sisters in Zille, I offer my humble prayers and deepest blessings."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dear brethren, today heralds a sac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dear brethren, today heralds a sacred moment as we witness the return of Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For it was through our enduring fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "For it was through our enduring faith in the Almighty that this victory has been attained."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, it was through our enduri..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, it was through our enduring faith in the Almighty that this triumph has been attained."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""United in our devotion and reveren..."
entries.dialogueText: "United in our devotion and reverence, let us give thanks for the divine grace that has reunited us with our brethren."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, we'll walk the path of r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we'll walk the path of righteousness, guided by the eternal light of our faith."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In conclusion, we extend prayers o..."
entries.dialogueText: "In conclusion, we extend prayers of gratitude and thanksgiving for the divine blessings that have brought Zille back into our fold."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And may our faith continue to stre..."
entries.dialogueText: "And may our faith continue to strengthen us as we embark on this sacred journey together."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The familiar scent of saltwater fil..."
entries.dialogueText: The familiar scent of saltwater filled the air, prompting old memories to rush back to me and a single word to escape my lips.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I really have missed this place, d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I really have missed this place, despite the dismal state."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll fix it up so that it's exact..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll fix it up so that it's exactly the way that it was."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a difficult time for all of..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a difficult time for all of us. But it's over now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand. Father's decision to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. Father's decision to hand over Zille to Wehlen cast a shadow over my entire reign."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stopped before turning to face..."
entries.dialogueText: She stopped before turning to face me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was my duty, Mother. For our ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was my duty, Mother. For our kingdom, and for our family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glad I could step in where Father..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glad I could step in where Father fell short. Wouldn't want his legacy tarnished any further."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's very kind of you to say. I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very kind of you to say. I'm truly touched."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille belongs with us. Plain and s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille belongs with us. Plain and simple."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And you fulfilled that duty admira..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you fulfilled that duty admirably, my dear."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The distant tolling of a bell tower..."
entries.dialogueText: The distant tolling of a bell tower interrupted her words.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Time to go. The festivities will b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time to go. The festivities will be starting soon. And someone here is scheduled to give a speech."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a nod of acknowledgment, we le..."
entries.dialogueText: With a nod of acknowledgment, we left her childhood home behind.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille.""
entries.dialogueText: "Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I never thought I'd see the day...""
entries.dialogueText: "I never thought I'd see the day..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The pain of what King Valero let u..."
entries.dialogueText: "The pain of what King Valero let us lose, you mean."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Consider the shadow lifted.""
entries.dialogueText: "Consider the shadow lifted."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Thank Dast for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank Dast for that."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Don't speak ill of your father. No..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't speak ill of your father. Now is neither the time nor the place."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Although, I would be remiss to ign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although, I would be remiss to ignore the impact his decisions have had on our family and kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Halting, Mother turned to face me."
entries.dialogueText: Halting, Mother turned to face me.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm proud of you, son. If not for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm proud of you, son. If not for your leadership, this house and so many others would have been lost forever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Trust me, Mother, you had it easy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me, Mother, you had it easy compared to the rest of us. And by us, I mean me."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Well, forgive me for not shedding..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, forgive me for not shedding tears over your royal discomfort."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An uncomfortable silence stretched..."
entries.dialogueText: An uncomfortable silence stretched between us. Finally, Mother broke the tension with a smile.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Well, I wouldn't say it if it wasn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I wouldn't say it if it wasn't true."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""His legacy may have had its flaws,..."
entries.dialogueText: "His legacy may have had its flaws, but please don't discount the sacrifices he made."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You've seen firsthand how hard it..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've seen firsthand how hard it is to keep this kingdom together..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The only thing left to do now is d..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only thing left to do now is decide who's in charge..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we made our way through the city..."
entries.dialogueText: As we made our way through the city, I felt a sense of renewal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The streets bustled with activity,..."
entries.dialogueText: The streets bustled with activity, alive with the energy of the festival. The once-damaged tenement buildings now stood proudly, freshly repainted to conceal the scars of the past.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long we passed a sign for Sm..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long we passed a sign for Smolak Square, where the event was being held.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soldiers from the Rizian army were..."
entries.dialogueText: Soldiers from the Rizian army were dispersed throughout the crowd, watchful for any sign of trouble.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Walking towards the center of the s..."
entries.dialogueText: Walking towards the center of the square, I couldn't ignore the solemnity of the moment.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Memories of that fateful day floode..."
entries.dialogueText: Memories of that fateful day flooded back to me -- the chaos, the screams, the confusion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It wasn't long before I was led to..."
entries.dialogueText: It wasn't long before I was led to the podium to deliver my speech. Mother gently placed her hand on my arm, stopping me.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Good luck.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""True change comes from within. Our..."
entries.dialogueText: "True change comes from within. Our focus should be on uplifting people's spirits before we tackle the task of renaming squares."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Back to Fedo Square?""
entries.dialogueText: "Back to Fedo Square?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's best we keep it as is. Knowin..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's best we keep it as is. Knowing Smolak, it'd be sure to cause an international incident."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You should have the square's name..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should have the square's name changed as soon as humanly possible."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're absolutely right, Mother. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're absolutely right, Mother. It's time to rid our city of reminders of the past."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The Sazons would love that, I'm ce..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons would love that, I'm certain."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If renaming a square is all it tak..."
entries.dialogueText: "If renaming a square is all it takes to cause an international incident, then perhaps we need to reevaluate our diplomatic strategy."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Good. The last thing we'd want is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. The last thing we'd want is any reminder of that slimeball."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If that's what you believe, dear,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's what you believe, dear, then I won't argue."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you. I'll do my best to repr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. I'll do my best to represent our kingdom with dignity and grace as you have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Luck is for the weak, Mother. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Luck is for the weak, Mother. But thanks all the same."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Good luck?' Please... I make my o..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Good luck?' Please... I make my own luck."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate the sentiment, Mother..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the sentiment, Mother. May the divine light guide my words and actions as I address our people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A smile graced her lips before she..."
entries.dialogueText: A smile graced her lips before she gave me a light kiss on the cheek.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother rolled he eyes and shook her..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother rolled he eyes and shook her head, seeming only slightly annoyed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A gentle smile adorned her face bef..."
entries.dialogueText: A gentle smile adorned her face before she kissed me on the cheek.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother rolled her eyes and shook he..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother rolled her eyes and shook her head, though her demeanor suggested she wasn't truly upset.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I stepped onto the stage and too..."
entries.dialogueText: As I stepped onto the stage and took my place behind the podium, the crowd erupted in applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I finished my speech, the crowd..."
entries.dialogueText: As I finished my speech, the crowd broke into loud cheers once more, their joy reverberating through the square.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I accepted it, quickly scanning its..."
entries.dialogueText: I accepted it, quickly scanning its contents before taking up the pen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And without a moment's hesitation,..."
entries.dialogueText: And without a moment's hesitation, I signed my name, fulfilling a promise now complete.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced over at my mother. She ha..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced over at my mother. She had tears shining in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Offering her a reassuring smile, I..."
entries.dialogueText: Offering her a reassuring smile, I turned back to the crowd, the memory of their praise etched into my mind forever.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother and I stood before the ch..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother and I stood before the chain-link fence that now surrounded her old childhood home in Zille.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The beachfront shack looked as rund..."
entries.dialogueText: The beachfront shack looked as rundown as before, but, this time, a giant Wehlen flag fluttered proudly from its facade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother turned to me, simmering with..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother turned to me, simmering with palpable resentment.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""So it's Smolak's house now. I can'..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it's Smolak's house now. I can't believe my beloved son would agree to such a thing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Would you rather that all of Zille..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would you rather that all of Zille belonged to him?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Of course not. But this parting sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not. But this parting shot of his is almost too insulting to bear."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother sighed heavily, her anger wa..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother sighed heavily, her anger warring with her sense of duty.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But you made the right decision. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you made the right decision. You didn't stoop to his childish level."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I truly regret promising it to him..."
entries.dialogueText: "I truly regret promising it to him. But it was the only option left after years of negotiation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was falling apart anyway. You'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was falling apart anyway. You'd never have moved back in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It wasn't a one-sided bargain. Did..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't a one-sided bargain. Did you see the doorstopper he gave me?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""He was toying with you, Romus. As..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was toying with you, Romus. As he has been for years."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You know that's not the point, dar..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know that's not the point, darling."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, I saw it, all right. No buts a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I saw it, all right. No buts about it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a final look back at the h..."
entries.dialogueText: She took a final look back at the house.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm proud of you, son. If not for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm proud of you, son. If not for your leadership, many more homes than mine would have been lost."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the other side of the square, a..."
entries.dialogueText: On the other side of the square, a group of Derdian and Bludish Golcondists led a series of victorious-sounding chants. I could just make out the words "Yollak Bluderat!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only a select few knew that the cro..."
entries.dialogueText: Only a select few knew that the crowd had been meticulously orchestrated, ensuring that only my supporters were present.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My thoughts were then abruptly inte..."
entries.dialogueText: My thoughts were then abruptly interrupted by the distant shouts of Wehzek protesters at the back of the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "With a brief nod and a discreet han..."
entries.dialogueText: With a brief nod and a discreet hand gesture, I indicated for the protesters to be removed as quietly as possible, without making a scene.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Even if you had to resort to rathe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if you had to resort to rather... unconventional tactics."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate your sentiments, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your sentiments, but let's not overlook the people of Zille. Their votes and collective will are the reason why we're here today."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Their resilience was truly remarka..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their resilience was truly remarkable. All those years without giving up hope..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Ah, yes, the power of this so-call..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes, the power of this so-called 'democracy at work' I keep hearing about. No extra persuasion necessary, I'm sure..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I spotted a group of Su Omina membe..."
entries.dialogueText: I spotted a group of Su Omina members, proudly displaying their insignia and banners.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A group of ATA volunteers glared at..."
entries.dialogueText: A group of ATA volunteers glared at them in obvious contempt.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Local Zille representatives approac..."
entries.dialogueText: Local Zille representatives approached me, holding a leather portfolio containing the legislation that would officially reunify Zille with Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I accepted it, quickly scanning the..."
entries.dialogueText: I accepted it, quickly scanning the referendum results before taking up the pen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother briefly paused when she reac..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother briefly paused when she reached the bedroom, gazing ruefully at the peeling paint on the walls.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I chose to ignore the protesters."
entries.dialogueText: I chose to ignore the protesters.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was then that I noticed my daugh..."
entries.dialogueText: It was then that I noticed my daughter and her husband sitting in the very front row. Manus' eyes met with mine.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Next to him, Angelica Sazon wore a..."
entries.dialogueText: Next to him, Angelica Sazon wore a deadly serious expression on her face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The applause subsided. I began to s..."
entries.dialogueText: The applause subsided. I began to speak.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was then that I noticed Angelica..."
entries.dialogueText: It was then that I noticed Angelica Sazon in the front row. She wore a deadly serious expression on her face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Cheers erupted once more."
entries.dialogueText: Cheers erupted once more.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As you all know, Zille has histori..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you all know, Zille has historically been a vital part of the province of Brenas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank the members of House Sazon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank the members of House Sazon for their patience in awaiting the return of this part of their ancestral homeland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must not forget the reason we l..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must not forget the reason we lost Zille in the first place. Because of the rebellion led by the traitorous Duke Lucas Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I myself attach many happy childho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I myself attach many happy childhood memories to Zille. It holds a special place in my heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I myself am one-half Zillean. This..."
entries.dialogueText: "I myself am one-half Zillean. This region holds a special place in my heart and that of my mother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is with joy that I announce the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is with joy that I announce the return of Zille to its original custodians, Brenas and House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, I'm a forgiving king. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I'm a forgiving king. Therefore, I announce the return of this land to its rightful custodians. Zille shall once again belong to Brenas and House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To return it to the Sazons would r..."
entries.dialogueText: "To return it to the Sazons would reward their misdeeds. I therefore announce that Zille will be governed like Rizia Imperii, by the central government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, returning it outright wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, returning it outright would reward the Sazons for their misdeeds. Therefore, Zille shall be ruled by the central government, just as Rizia Imperii."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But in these precarious times, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "But in these precarious times, we need unity, not feudalism. Zille shall be guided by the firm hand of the central government, not a noble house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But in these precarious times, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "But in these precarious times, we need unity, not feudalism. Zille shall be firmly governed by the central authority, not one noble house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the meantime, the Sazons have p..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, the Sazons have proven themselves to be great allies. I shall therefore allow them to resume governance of the region that was taken from them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And now that House Sazon and House..."
entries.dialogueText: And now that House Sazon and House Toras are reconciled, I find it only fitting to name the Sazons stewards of this land once more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope that House Sazon will take..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope that House Sazon will take good care of it once it is reincorporated into Brenas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I, therefore, cannot simply hand i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I, therefore, cannot simply hand it back to House Sazon and Brenas. It will belong to the central government's jurisdiction, as Rizia Imperii."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is with joy in my heart that I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is with joy in my heart that I announce the return of Zille to its original custodians, Brenas and House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In that spirit, and in the interes..."
entries.dialogueText: "In that spirit, and in the interest of promoting unity over feudalism, Zille shall belong to Rizia Imperii from henceforth onwards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was some applause from the cr..."
entries.dialogueText: There was some applause from the crowd, as well as a few murmurs of concern.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica Sazon angrily rose from he..."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica Sazon angrily rose from her seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her son grabbed her arm and gently..."
entries.dialogueText: Her son grabbed her arm and gently persuaded her to sit down once more.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a haughty glance in my directi..."
entries.dialogueText: With a haughty glance in my direction, she turned and left.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica Sazon stood and applauded..."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica Sazon stood and applauded fiercely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus and Vina joined her."
entries.dialogueText: Manus and Vina joined her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A group of Sazon supporters began c..."
entries.dialogueText: A group of Sazon supporters began chanting "Glovurius axa Sazoni!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I motioned for the crowd to quiet d..."
entries.dialogueText: I motioned for the crowd to quiet down. I had to finish my speech.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As my mother and I stepped out of t..."
entries.dialogueText: As my mother and I stepped out of the car, we were met with a sea of cheering faces, their palpable enthusiasm filling the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The scent of saltwater filled the a..."
entries.dialogueText: The scent of saltwater filled the air. Almost involuntarily, a single word escaped her lips.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Zille.""
entries.dialogueText: "Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll turn it into a magnificent v..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll turn it into a magnificent villa. The Queen Mother's very own luxury retreat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You and me both.""
entries.dialogueText: "You and me both."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That would just feel wrong. Althou..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would just feel wrong. Although I wouldn't mind upgrading the bed linens to a higher thread count."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Nothing will be exactly the way it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing will be exactly the way it was, darling. We can't bring back the past."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm glad you're as attached to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you're as attached to the house as I am. It shows the King hasn't forgotten his roots."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But bringing back the house? That..."
entries.dialogueText: "But bringing back the house? That would be lovely."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Personally, I had no doubt in my m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Personally, I had no doubt in my mind that Zille would be ours again."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I look forward to the day when I c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to the day when I can come here without being reminded of the pain of what we lost."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't get too used to it. I gave t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get too used to it. I gave the Sords permission to turn the house into another resort."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stared daggers at me."
entries.dialogueText: She stared daggers at me.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If you think that's funny, you're..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you think that's funny, you're as bad as Smolak."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I spotted a group of ATA volunteers..."
entries.dialogueText: I spotted a group of ATA volunteers, proudly waving Rizian flags.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the other side of the square, a..."
entries.dialogueText: On the other side of the square, a group of Derdian Golcondists led a series of victorious-sounding chants.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the other side of the square, a..."
entries.dialogueText: On the other side of the square, a group of Bludish Wehzeks led a series of victorious-sounding chants. I could just make out the words "Yollak Bluderat!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "AN peacekeeping forces were dispers..."
entries.dialogueText: AN peacekeeping forces were dispersed throughout the crowd, watchful for any sign of trouble.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon's brow was knitted. Vin..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon's brow was knitted. Vina put a comforting arm around him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked alongside my mother throug..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked alongside my mother through her dilapidated childhood home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked alongside my mother throug..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked alongside my mother through her dilapidated childhood home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Where the former grandstand once st..."
entries.dialogueText: Where the former grandstand once stood, there was now a memorial to the victims of the bombing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were shouting that the will of..."
entries.dialogueText: They were shouting that the will of the people of Zille had been ignored.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some audience members joined them w..."
entries.dialogueText: Some audience members joined them while others sat with their arms crossed, looking dissatisfied.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
